questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine market economy using anthropological evidence

stimulus.body: A town has a central plaza where goods are traded at prices that shift with supply and demand, and most residents earn cash to buy what they need.

questions.stem: Which statement about market economy is best supported by the account?

A market economy is one in which all goods are allocated by custom and inheritance with no prices.

options.text: A market economy is a system in which money has been completely abolished and never used.

options.text: A market economy exists only in societies with no government of any kind.
options.misconception: It denies the use of money, which the case explicitly describes.

questions.explanation: It wrongly requires the absence of government, whereas markets usually operate within legal frameworks.
questions.hint: Market economies still depend on social institutions such as property rights and trust.

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY

stimulus.body: A community uses shell discs that are accepted in payment for goods, are counted in standard units, and can be stored for later use.

questions.stem: The evidence most strongly supports which claim about money?

questions.explanation: It assigns the term to a measure of weight, which is a different function.

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
